review_evidence: README explicitly describes the project as verified efficient algorithms in Lean 4.
Twenty-one of 35 Lean files contain proposition declarations, totaling 354 theorem/lemma/axiom/example lines.
Graph/DFS.lean and Graph/Dijkstra.lean prove algorithm specifications, while data-structure modules prove invariants for mutable quotients, heaps, finite-support structures and related interfaces.
summary: Reviewed Algorithm; retain its verified algorithms and supporting data-structure theorem development.
